details: Characteristic-zero instance of the Yang generator-count bound.
proof: Yang's canonical ideal has one minimal monomial generator for each concept. The Taylor resolution on $|\mathcal H|$ generators over $\mathbb Q$ has length at most $|\mathcal H|-1$ for a nonempty class. Thus $\mathrm Y_0(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|$ (and the empty class has value 0 by convention).
name: Size / Characteristic-zero Yang Dimension
